work.edition_title: Избранные математические работы Эмми Нётер — полное русское издание
work.content_scope: Papers 1-43, the 1929/30 hypercomplex-quantities lectures, Paper 45, and the Russian bibliography

canonical_lane_head.meaning: Canonical for this Russian edition lane only; not a prescriptive canon of Russian mathematical language and not native certification.

derived_reader.relationship: deterministic serial two-pass XeLaTeX build from the four authenticated sources plus one authenticated rosette asset

project_german_authority.claim_boundary: Project editorial authority, not a critical or canonical German edition.

authority_chain.translation_status: Russian translation/typesetting lane assembled from versioned translation witnesses and subsequently source-fidelity audited.
authority_chain.native_canon_status: No harvested corpus or reference file is admitted as a general native-Russian canon.
authority_chain.human_review_status: No native-Russian community review has been completed; this is disclosed and was not used as a release gate.

logical_locator_resolution.meaning: A stable logical root for the Noether source/translation corpus; suffixes retain work, structural unit, language, version, and witness filename.
logical_locator_resolution.public_resolution: Resolve through this index, the evidence/provenance package, and the linked global/German DOI objects; never reconstruct a private user-directory path.

evidence_classes.project_authority: German ED0015 and directly cited primary/source objects
evidence_classes.translation_witnesses: Versioned Russian translation units; evidence of this edition's lineage, not automatically native canon
evidence_classes.terminology_evidence: Adjudicated dictionary, catalogue, research, and parallel-language evidence with source-role boundaries in decision records
evidence_classes.generated_comparators: Other translation lanes may be comparison evidence only and never native-Russian authority
evidence_classes.deterministic_outputs: PDF and public archives derived from pinned editable sources; not independent textual witnesses

extension_protocol: Read this index, the current decision ledger, and the head record before editing.
Pin every input by byte count and SHA-256; never edit German or another language lane from this lane.
Add one monotonic decision row with exact locators, before/after text or formula, evidence roles, rejected alternatives, uncertainty, and reverse replay.
Preserve immutable witnesses; write a local producer successor when a source unit must diverge.
Regenerate the cumulative reader serially, require two byte-identical builds, and repeat affected-page plus boundary visual QA.
Update this index only after the successor source, ledger, build, and QA identities are sealed.
Publish only a meaningful non-duplicative successor in the existing repository and DOI lineage, then anonymously rehash every public artifact.
nonclaims: not a prescriptive canon for Russian mathematics
the deterministic PDF is not an independent translation witness
